description: This file contains server-side logic for the EditMCQ ASP.NET page in the Online Examination System. It manages UI interactions such as navigation, dynamic dropdown population based on semester selection, and session handling.

classes.name: EditMCQ
classes.description: Partial class representing server-side logic for the EditMCQ ASP.NET Web Forms page.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles initial page load; currently does nothing.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the Admin Panel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the Admin Queue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the Admin Leaderboard page.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates the course dropdown based on the selected semester.

methods.name: searchB_Click
methods.description: Stores selected course in session variable.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the Login page, effectively logging out.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates course dropdown based on semester selection.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Empty handler for course selection change.
